# Whisperer

> Whisperer is a Mac app for AI meeting notes and dictation that runs on the Mac. It detects calls in Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Slack huddles and Webex, records both sides without a bot, names every speaker, and writes the summary, decisions and action items with the user's own AI (a Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini plan, an API key) or a free built-in model that works offline. It includes Google Calendar and Outlook sync, Ask AI with timestamped sources, a local MCP server for AI apps, and hold-to-talk dictation in 97 languages. The app costs $2.99 and Pro costs $14.99, both one-time purchases on the Mac App Store. No subscription and no account.

## Key facts
- Platform: macOS 26 Tahoe or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/whisperer-voice-to-text/id6758626671
- Price: $2.99 app (dictation). Pro is a $14.99 one-time in-app purchase that adds meetings, meeting detection, calendar sync, AI notes, Ask AI, bring-your-own-AI and the MCP server. No minute limits.
- Privacy: audio, transcription and speaker detection stay on the Mac. No account, no analytics, no tracking; App Store label "Data Not Collected". A cloud AI only receives the text transcript, only if the user picks one.
- Meeting notes: detection by which app opened the microphone; prompt or automatic recording for calendar meetings; live transcript; on-device speaker diarization with names from the calendar invite; overview, key topics, decisions, action items, open questions, next meeting; Ask AI with sources; search across meetings; audio retention setting; no bot joins the call.
- Bring your own AI: built-in Qwen3.5 4B model (offline, free, default and fallback); Claude (Pro/Max), ChatGPT (Plus/Pro), Codex (ChatGPT plan) and Gemini (Google AI Pro/Ultra) plan sign-in with no extra bill; OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini API keys stored in the macOS Keychain.
- MCP server: local Model Context Protocol server, off by default, loopback only, optional bearer token, optional LAN access, Streamable HTTP at /mcp. One-click setup for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and Antigravity; ChatGPT via a developer-mode connector with a tunnel URL. Tools: list_meetings, get_meeting, get_meeting_transcript, search_meetings, list_meeting_notes, add_meeting_note, update_meeting_note, delete_meeting_note, search_transcriptions, get_transcription.
- Dictation: hold Fn, speak, release; live preview in the spoken language; text is copied for pasting with Cmd+V. Offline engines: Whisper (whisper.cpp on Metal, default Large V3 Turbo, 97 languages), Parakeet (25 languages), Qwen3 ASR (31 languages), WhisperKit; Apple Speech powers the live preview. Personal dictionary that learns corrections, file transcription, history, statistics.
